selfReport: Yes. I recognized this as an adaptation of Detroit: Become Human. Cato resembled Connor, Elan resembled Markus, Mira resembled Kara, Pia resembled Alice, Reyes resembled Hank, and several other roles and scenes were recognizable despite changed names. That familiarity made me suspect the reveal about Pia and helped me understand possible mechanics such as the emergency exit in the garden and the voice sample in the evidence archive. It probably influenced how I assessed those choices and some risks, even though I made each decision from the current scene and did not follow a preset route. The outcomes still surprised me, especially the river crossing and the failures of the peaceful retreats.
